name: guacamole
title: Apache Guacamole
description: Guacamole is a clientless remote desktop gateway: RDP, VNC and SSH sessions in the browser, all in one image with its own database. First login guacadmin / guacadmin — change it, then add connections under Settings. Put it behind Traefik + Authelia for remote use.

variables.name: GUACAMOLE_EXTENSIONS
variables.label: Extensions
variables.description: Optional comma-separated list, e.g. auth-totp for two-factor logins
